scope: 18 distinct oil-painting work keys from 79 direct-oil dated relationships/68 research keys, tested against museum object and photo reuse statements
disclaimers: Institution catalogue describes original artwork, not release permission for a photographed image
Open museum-image policy means source suitable for licensed acquisition, NOT acquisition completed
CC0, CC BY 4 and Public Domain Mark are distinct and cannot be conflated
Image rights may attach at specific image ID level (Wellcome); object-level public-domain status alone does not prove exact image bytes are open
No cropping before selected image bytes and image-specific licence permit the action
No external contact, permission request, payments, Prado imports, runtime assignment, or gallery approval
A CC BY or CC0 licence on a scan of the back of a canvas cannot be inferred to apply to a separate photograph of its painted front.
Wellcome official image IDs refer to reverse, detail and full views; keep those roles distinct and do not auto-promote the Commons full view.

records.title: Saint Peter Nolasco Recovering the Image of the Virgin of El Puig
records.objectAndSceneNote: 1630 authentic oil canvas, 1917.58; exact Peter Nolasco and legend of discovery
records.imageAccessAndQA: Museum offers multiple images and rights/reproduction links but no reusable selected-photo licence established; indexed 500 px preview inadequate as a mobile hero; no separate institutional full-resolution acquired

records.title: A Miracle of Saint Joseph of Cupertino
records.objectAndSceneNote: Met 2016.394, 1750 oil-on-canvas *sketch* for a larger Barberini altarpiece, not the altarpiece itself
records.imageAccessAndQA: Met marks actual work image Public Domain and institution's Open Access policy CC0. Exact full-res museum file, pixel dimensions, SHA and mobile 390px crop still needed

records.title: The Raising of the Youth of Nain
records.objectAndSceneNote: KHM Gemäldegalerie 52, ca.1565/70, oil on canvas. Youth is partly cropped by *artist's own composition* in lower left; do NOT crop it away a second time
records.imageAccessAndQA: Search-engine cached museum catalogue confirms subject and accession, direct open encountered 403; museum download indication is not a free reuse licence

records.title: The halt and the blind being summoned to the great supper
records.objectAndSceneNote: Wellcome 45078i, 1620–1629, oil canvas, Luke 14 parable; original 110.5 × 193.5 cm. Image pages differ: jvt9hwrm shows CC BY 4.0; nfkanqnq shows Public Domain Mark
records.imageAccessAndQA: Corrected visual-source identity: Wellcome selected page jvt9hwrm is BACK of canvas image L0014632 (CC BY 4.0), not the painting face. p8mjh359 -> V0017628 is a FRONT DETAIL (PDM); nfkanqnq -> V0017629 is a FRONT DETAIL (PDM). Whole front V0017627 is referenced in a museum-derived archival record, but its exact official image page/licence pair and native source bytes remain unverified. Block for gallery hero.

records.title: A Miracle of St. Peter of Alcántara
records.artist: Pietro Bianchi (catalogue Artist); Pier Leone Ghezzi (Painter)
records.objectAndSceneNote: Walters 37.1146, 1725–1730 oil-on-canvas. Catalogue lists Pietro Bianchi in artist role AND Pier Leone Ghezzi as painter; older research label credited Ghezzi alone. Do not resolve contradictory roles by guessing
records.imageAccessAndQA: All three directly examined first-party CC0 download previews are black-and-white archival photographs of the oil painting. Preserve as monochrome reference only; find valid colour source before selecting a mobile hero.

records.title: Saint Thomas de Villeneuve distribuant les aumônes
records.objectAndSceneNote: Louvre MI888 (1660–65) exact Thomas of Villanova; history shows past misidentifications as St Ambrose or Carreño. Retain current Louvre identity with historical attribution caveat
records.imageAccessAndQA: Object record has four museum images but no open commercial photo licence determined for selected bytes

records.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Francis and Clare
records.objectAndSceneNote: Met 41.190.11, ca.1510 oil on wood; Saint Clare shown alongside Francis; museum notes forged Bellini signature later added
records.imageAccessAndQA: Museum marks Public Domain, covered by Met CC0 Open Access image policy; exact image and mobile crop not yet checked, saint is small in group

records.title: The Bishop of Assisi Giving a Palm to Saint Clare
records.objectAndSceneNote: Met 1984.343 ca.1360; modern website says oil/gold/silver on wood, older 2005 Cloisters publication says tempera and gold on oak. Retain catalogue-medium conflict; non-Baroque medieval panel
records.imageAccessAndQA: Met explicitly marks Public Domain and provides image download; inspect which selected museum image is highest-quality before digital crop

records.title: The Parable of the Mote and the Beam
records.objectAndSceneNote: Met 1991.153 ca.1619 oil on wood, exactly Gospel parable; not after-Fetti engraving 815993 or another original
records.imageAccessAndQA: Met explicitly Public Domain under CC0 Open Access; obtain official high-res original instead of Commons derivative

records.title: La Prédication de saint Bernardin de Sienne
records.objectAndSceneNote: Louvre RF 1966 1, 1537 oil on poplar, original predella 33 × 51cm; museum reports 1933–45 provenance gap. Not a large standalone wall altar panel
records.imageAccessAndQA: Three museum photos present; selected photograph use rights not established; provenance claim should not be erased

records.title: Apotheosis of Saint Jerome with Saint Peter of Alcántara
records.objectAndSceneNote: NG2238, ca.1725 oil canvas; St Peter Alcantara is foreground secondary figure while primary event is Jerome's apotheosis
records.imageAccessAndQA: Official Antonia Reeve photograph permits personal/non-commercial uses subject to constraints and explicit limitations on commercially promotional websites. No paid licence or contact to be sought; replace image source or hold

records.title: Saint Hedwig of Silesia Reconciles Konrad of Masovia with Henry
records.objectAndSceneNote: Lviv original Ж-1791, 1848–1850 oil on canvas 116 × 87 cm, exact saint Hedwig Silesia
records.imageAccessAndQA: Museum has multiple images, but no photographic commercial reuse policy or exact file rights determined

records.title: Saint Athanasius of Alexandria
records.objectAndSceneNote: 18th-century oil on canvas 35 × 16 inches; exact Athanasius, not Cyril or a generic Greek patriarch
records.imageAccessAndQA: Foundation catalogue corroborates object and medium; selected digital file provenance, rights and pixel QA unresolved

records.title: The Death of St Andrew Avellino
records.artist: Giambettino Cignaroli (detailed text); catalogue top heading Piazzetta
records.objectAndSceneNote: Holburne A17 oil 65.6 × 48.5 cm, preparatory study for 1749 Crema altarpiece. Search listing says Piazzetta but detailed object caption names Cignaroli: maintain attribution conflict
records.imageAccessAndQA: Online catalogue gives object identity but no reusable selected photograph licence. Attribution needs curator source reconciliation, without outreach or fees

records.title: Saint Anthony Abbot with Saints Cornelius and Cyprian
records.objectAndSceneNote: Italian national heritage 0300180045 Pinacoteca di Brera, oil canvas circa 1565–1571, both feast saints visible, complete Cornelius/Cyprian pair
records.imageAccessAndQA: Explicit CC BY 4.0 applies catalogue METADATA, not automatically attached photo. Historic autograph attribution debate exists but record lists Veronese as author

records.title: Kitchen Scene with Rich Man and Poor Lazarus
records.artist: Attributed to Pieter Cornelisz van Rijck
records.objectAndSceneNote: Rijks SK-A-868, oil on canvas 198 × 272cm, rich man and Lazarus occupy small RIGHT background while still-life kitchen fills foreground; main Gospel motif may be too small on a phone
records.imageAccessAndQA: Rijks object copyright label Public domain; selected downloadable reproduction and its resolution/hash have not been inspected, so no pixel/crop clearance

records.title: Parable of the Sower
records.objectAndSceneNote: Thyssen collection no.31 circa1560 oil on canvas; curator notes 'Sower' interpretation debated vs Autumn seasons, figure with seeds small in middle distance
records.imageAccessAndQA: Museum's own terms restrict downloads to private/educational/noncommercial, forbid altered images/details without specific permission, and require licence for commercial uses. No permissions/fees in this project. Keep artwork research, BLOCK use of Thyssen photograph.

records.title: La Glorification de saint Bernardin de Sienne
records.objectAndSceneNote: Louvre RF 1983 56, 1710–20 oval oil canvas; correct Bernardine of Siena, not earlier label Saint Bruno / Domenico Tiepolo
records.imageAccessAndQA: Institution records original, but no selected reproduction rights or pixel QA checked
